about: Ours, not shadcn's: class lists in shadcn's style, from its own patterns and tokens, for hxmc's widgets shadcn lacks (Tree, Listbox, Sortable, NumberField, TagInput, ColorPicker, Toolbar, Collapsible) and hxmc's parts that are not shadcn's (the calendar's day and nav, the field rows, icons, sonner's toast, its stylesheet's values as classes, a group heading); shadcn.json includes it, its slots over shadcn's (packages/theme/README.md)

class: relative aspect-square size-(--cell-size) p-0 text-center leading-none font-normal select-none dark:hover:text-accent-foreground

slots.calendar-nav: flex h-(--cell-size) w-full items-center justify-between gap-1
slots.collapsible-trigger: flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all outline-none hover:underline focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50
slots.color-picker-area: relative cursor-crosshair overflow-hidden rounded-md border outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50
slots.color-picker-hue: relative h-3.5 rounded-full outline-none focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50
slots.color-picker-thumb: size-3 rounded-full border-2 border-white shadow-sm ring-1 ring-black/20
slots.listbox: flex flex-col rounded-md border bg-background p-1 shadow-xs
slots.listbox-option: relative flex shrink-0 cursor-default items-center gap-2 rounded-sm px-2 py-1.5 text-sm outline-hidden select-none hover:bg-accent/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 aria-selected:bg-accent aria-selected:text-accent-foreground
slots.number-field-decrement: flex flex-1 cursor-default items-center justify-center rounded-b-md border border-input bg-transparent px-2 text-[8px] text-muted-foreground shadow-xs hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50
slots.number-field-increment: flex flex-1 cursor-default items-center justify-center rounded-t-md border border-input bg-transparent px-2 text-[8px] text-muted-foreground shadow-xs hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50

pagination-link.class: data-[active=true]:border data-[active=true]:bg-background data-[active=true]:shadow-xs data-[active=true]:hover:bg-accent data-[active=true]:hover:text-accent-foreground dark:data-[active=true]:border-input dark:data-[active=true]:bg-input/30 dark:data-[active=true]:hover:bg-input/50

slots.sortable-item: relative flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-sm text-card-foreground shadow-xs outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50
slots.tag-input: flex min-h-9 w-full min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-2 py-1 text-base shadow-xs transition-[color,box-shadow] md:text-sm dark:bg-input/30
slots.tag-input-field: h-7 w-full min-w-0 bg-transparent px-1 text-base outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground md:text-sm
slots.toast: flex w-[356px] items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-popover p-4 text-[13px] text-popover-foreground shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]
slots.toast-action: ml-auto flex h-6 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-[4px] bg-popover-foreground px-2 text-xs font-medium text-popover outline-none focus-visible:shadow-[0_0_0_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]
slots.toast-close: absolute top-0 left-0 z-1 flex size-5 -translate-x-[35%] -translate-y-[35%] cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full border bg-popover p-0 text-popover-foreground
slots.toolbar: flex h-9 items-center gap-1 rounded-md border bg-background p-1 shadow-xs
slots.tree: flex flex-col rounded-md border bg-background p-1 text-sm outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50
slots.tree-item: flex cursor-default items-center gap-1 rounded-sm px-2 text-sm select-none hover:bg-accent/50 data-[selected=true]:bg-accent data-[selected=true]:text-accent-foreground
